#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a project kickoff meeting ICS for next Monday, 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM local time."""
import datetime
import uuid

OUT = "project_kickoff.ics"
SUMMARY = "Project Kickoff Meeting"


def next_monday(today):
    """First Monday strictly after today."""
    days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return today + datetime.timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def main():
    now_local = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone()
    monday = next_monday(now_local.date())
    start_local = datetime.datetime(
        monday.year, monday.month, monday.day, 10, 0, 0, tzinfo=now_local.tzinfo
    )
    end_local = start_local + datetime.timedelta(hours=2)
    start_utc = start_local.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)
    end_utc = end_local.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)
    uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar.local"
    dtstamp = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

    generated_with = None
    try:
        from icalendar import Calendar, Event, Alarm

        cal = Calendar()
        cal.add("prodid", "-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN")
        cal.add("version", "2.0")
        cal.add("calscale", "GREGORIAN")
        cal.add("method", "PUBLISH")

        event = Event()
        event.add("uid", uid)
        event.add("dtstamp", dtstamp)
        event.add("dtstart", start_utc)
        event.add("dtend", end_utc)
        event.add("summary", SUMMARY)
        event.add(
            "description",
            "Project kickoff meeting. Scheduled 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM local time.",
        )
        event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
        event.add("sequence", 0)
        event.add("transp", "OPAQUE")

        alarm = Alarm()
        alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
        alarm.add("description", "Project kickoff meeting starts in 15 minutes.")
        alarm.add("trigger", datetime.timedelta(minutes=-15))
        event.add_component(alarm)

        cal.add_component(event)
        payload = cal.to_ical()
        generated_with = "icalendar"
    except ImportError:
        payload = (
            "BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\n"
            "VERSION:2.0\r\n"
            "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN\r\n"
            "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN\r\n"
            "METHOD:PUBLISH\r\n"
            "BEGIN:VEVENT\r\n"
            f"UID:{uid}\r\n"
            f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}\r\n"
            f"DTSTART:{start_utc.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}\r\n"
            f"DTEND:{end_utc.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}\r\n"
            f"SUMMARY:{SUMMARY}\r\n"
            "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting. Scheduled 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM local time.\r\n"
            "STATUS:CONFIRMED\r\n"
            "SEQUENCE:0\r\n"
            "TRANSP:OPAQUE\r\n"
            "BEGIN:VALARM\r\n"
            "ACTION:DISPLAY\r\n"
            "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting starts in 15 minutes.\r\n"
            "TRIGGER:-PT15M\r\n"
            "END:VALARM\r\n"
            "END:VEVENT\r\n"
            "END:VCALENDAR\r\n"
        ).encode("utf-8")
        generated_with = "manual"

    with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
        f.write(payload)

    # --- Validation ---
    with open(OUT, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    text = data.decode("utf-8")

    checks = {
        "calendar container": "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" in text and "END:VCALENDAR" in text,
        "event container": "BEGIN:VEVENT" in text and "END:VEVENT" in text,
        "uid present": "UID:" in text,
        "dtstamp present": "DTSTAMP:" in text,
        "summary present": f"SUMMARY:{SUMMARY}" in text,
        "start present": f"DTSTART:{start_utc.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}" in text,
        "end present": f"DTEND:{end_utc.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}" in text,
        "end after start": end_utc > start_utc,
        "alarm present": "BEGIN:VALARM" in text and "TRIGGER:-PT15M" in text,
    }

    try:
        from icalendar import Calendar as ICal

        ICal.from_ical(data)
        checks["parses with icalendar"] = True
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - only if a parse issue exists
        checks["parses with icalendar"] = False

    print(f"Generated with: {generated_with}")
    print(f"File: {OUT}")
    print(f"Event date (next Monday): {monday.isoformat()}")
    print(f"Local start: {start_local.isoformat()}")
    print(f"Local end:   {end_local.isoformat()}")
    print(f"UTC start:   {start_utc.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')}")
    print(f"UTC end:     {end_utc.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')}")
    print(f"UID: {uid}")
    print(f"Validation: {checks}")
    if not all(checks.values()):
        sys_exit = 1
    else:
        sys_exit = 0
    raise SystemExit(sys_exit)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
